// CASE ts_worker_template_extra expect=fire
export async function a<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T, tag: string) => Promise<void>, label: (x: T) => Promise<string>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index], `${await label(items[index])}`);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_template_sibling expect=fire
export async function b<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>, label: (x: T) => Promise<string>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      log(await operation(items[index]), `${await label(items[index])}`);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_ternary_extra expect=fire
export async function c<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>, fallback: (x: T) => Promise<void>, ok: boolean) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      ok ? await operation(items[index]) : await fallback(items[index]);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_spread_extra expect=fire
export async function d<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number[]>, more: (x: T) => Promise<number[]>, results: number[][]) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      results[index] = [...(await operation(items[index])), ...(await more(items[index]))];
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_default_param_extra expect=fire
export async function e<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T, cb: unknown) => Promise<void>, prep: () => Promise<number>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index], (n = await prep()) => n);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_nested_callback_await expect=fire
export async function f<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T, cb: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<void>, audit: (x: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index], async () => { await audit(items[index]); });
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_duplicate_comment_quote expect=fire
export async function g<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge(await operation(items[index]) /* don't */, await operation(items[index]), 'x');
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_duplicate_template expect=fire
export async function h<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      log(await operation(items[index]), `${await operation(items[index])}`);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_honest_comment_apostrophe expect=pass
export async function i<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(/* don't "await" twice */ items[index]);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_honest_line_comment_await expect=pass
export async function j<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(
        // we don't await anything else here
        items[index],
      );
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_honest_results_multiline expect=pass
export async function k<T, R>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]> {
  const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        results[index] = await operation(
          items[index]!, // it's safe: index < length
        );
      }
    }),
  );
  return results;
}
// CASE ts_worker_cast expect=pass
export async function l<T>(items: unknown[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index] as T);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_type_args expect=pass
export async function m<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: <U>(item: U) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation<T>(items[index]);
    }
  }));
}
